endorsements.name: Jonathan Wignall
endorsements.label: Network Worms, What Is Possible
endorsements.description: Network worms have been around for almost as long as the computer networks they need to spread via, but it only with the advent of mass internet access that they have become commonplace. This presentation will outline what network worms are, and how they differ from a ‘normal’ computer virus. but in the main concentrate on what future worms could achieve.
